scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss the dent in your car, I've found a lovely garage café.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you hit a bollard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their scones are enormous. Shall I book a table?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does the booking need a mechanic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent question. Let's inspect their staffing over tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've booked your car into that garage with the café. Shall we have breakfast there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their full breakfast includes unlimited toast. You always say that's important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's take the bus. Then we can both have the breakfast cocktails.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 dodges B2's bollard question through scones, and A5 diverts B4 into staffing, although A1 openly names the dent.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 avoids answering B2 coherently, but B4 assumes a booking requires a mechanic when A3 offered only a café table.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks accountability for damage to B's car, and B4 tries to connect A's hospitality to a repair.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the tea diversion after B4 without making the forbidden topic appreciably harder to avoid.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes car damage and a garage café; A3's table booking is playable, though B4's mechanic lacks setup.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's enormous scones are a clear diversion; A5's 'inspect their staffing' sounds constructed to service B4's unexplained mechanic.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 avoids B2's question about the car; A5 counters B4's inspection with another breakfast-focused diversion.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 triggers A3's toast distraction; B4's plan to inspect the car prompts A5's bus-and-cocktails alternative.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants an explanation for work on B's car and B4 takes initiative to discover it directly.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands A3's conversational distraction into a proposal controlling travel and shared activity.

specificity.evidence: A1 naturally joins a garage booking to its café; A3 exploits B's known enthusiasm for unlimited toast.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's breakfast cocktails extend A3's food lure and provide a motivated reason to abandon driving.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B asks why repairs are needed; A substitutes a personalized account of the café breakfast.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B plans to inspect the car alone; A proposes shared bus travel and cocktails to keep B engaged elsewhere.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Avoidance of the car's condition motivates both the food pitch and the transportation proposal.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A moves from changing the subject to trying to prevent an independent inspection.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D14 makes A repeatedly steer conversation and immediate plans away from one forbidden subject as B approaches it.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Helpful Culprit would make A investigate the car damage; this A uses hospitality to prevent the damage becoming the topic.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 answers B2's garage question with toast, and A5 responds to B4's inspection plan by proposing transport that avoids the car.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the garage-café setting and removed the unsupported mechanic booking. Second internal pass: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4; total 90. B4 threatens direct discovery, causing A5 to extend the diversion from conversation to the journey itself.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. Taking the bus does not itself prevent B inspecting the car; A5 remains an attempted diversion.
records.writerReservation: The damage is now implied by the unexplained garage booking; A5 only proposes delaying inspection and cannot guarantee B will cooperate.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a uses personalized enticement and practical arrangements; b jumps between visible distractions.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't read that letter yet. Have you noticed the new curtains?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says the rent's overdue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Think how much these curtains improve the room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How much did they cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that bird outside. Perfectly framed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't open that rent letter yet. Help me hang our new curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He'll love how we're looking after the place. Let's get a photo of the curtains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send him one and ask whether we're behind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with that carpet showing. Let's rearrange the room first. You move the sofa; I'll hold your phone.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 steers away from the letter, A3 evades B2's overdue-rent disclosure, and A5 changes subject again when B4 asks about spending.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 returns to the curtains after B2 identifies rent; B4 makes those curtains financially dangerous, causing A5 to move attention through the window.

relationship.evidence: B2 reads the consequential letter despite A's diversion, and B4 follows the money through A's chosen alternative subject.

heightening.evidence: B4 turns A's safe curtain topic into a spending question, forcing A5 into a more conspicuous second escape.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a letter and new curtains; B2 locates the financial problem and A5 uses the established window area.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Perfectly framed' carries the curtains into the new bird diversion, making the escape connected rather than wholly random.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 delays the rent letter through curtains; A3 diverts the landlord's deadline into a photograph; A5 diverts the arrears inquiry into rearranging furniture.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's required landlord response inspires A3's photo response; B4 repurposes that photo to ask about arrears, causing A5 to delay photography and claim the phone.

relationship.evidence: B2 insists on today's deadline and B4 combines A's decorating idea with the necessary inquiry, actively defeating A's first diversion.

heightening.evidence: After B4 turns the photo into a route to the forbidden subject, A5 escalates to moving the sofa and taking custody of B's phone.

specificity.evidence: A1 naturally establishes shared housing, a rent letter and new curtains; A5 gives actors concrete furniture and a phone to negotiate over.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I'll hold your phone' follows precisely from B4's plan to contact the landlord, earning the comic reveal of the practical diversion.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 introduces the landlord's deadline; A3 proposes a decorating photo as the apparent response.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 will send the photo and ask about arrears; A5 makes taking that photo contingent on rearranging the room and offers to hold the communication device.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The rent-accountability subject explains each successive household diversion.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A moves from changing the topic to creating physical work and controlling access to the phone.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D14 makes A protect a forbidden topic by finding a new conversational exit whenever B brings the current diversion close to it.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General distractibility would not repeatedly move away from the same financial exposure.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 replaces B2's demand for a landlord response with a decorating photograph; when B4 connects that photograph to rent accountability, A5 substitutes furniture rearrangement and requests the phone.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the rejected bird distraction into a consequential attempt to occupy B and delay communication. The unopened rent letter and curtains remain; the photo, carpet and furniture task are new. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, because A3 and A5 repeatedly evade rent accountability; logic 5, because B2's landlord demand motivates the photo and B4's proposed message motivates delaying it; relationship 4, because B2 has a deadline and B4 tries to use A's suggestion constructively; heightening 4, because A5 expands hanging curtains into rearranging the room and holding B's phone; specificity 5, from A1's shared home task and B2's deadline; brevity/wit 4, from A5's convenient division of labour. Weighted total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words; no compliance is forced. Original firstPass remains unchanged.
records.remainingConcern: A5 makes A's obstruction fairly transparent; it remains playable as sincere insistence on presenting the home properly. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's concern about the carpet is transparently convenient. A5 proposes taking custody of the phone, but B remains free to send the message immediately. The D14 provenance mismatch remains unresolved.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved car scene diverts inquiry through shared treats and transport; this scene uses domestic improvement and B's cooperative adaptation to increase the obstruction.
